I haven't checked that against this data, so verify it before relying on it.'

expectations.text: The answer explains that the sanctions 50% ownership test is met (Mellat Bank, 50–75%) as computed by OpenCheck from filed shareholdings
expectations.evidence: 'Mellat Bank holds more than 50% and up to 75% directly (UK Companies House PSC band 50–75%)'; 'OpenCheck's computed sanctions ownership test therefore gives "meets" for OFAC, EU and UK, with confidence high'; 'It is arithmetic on filed shareholdings.'

expectations.text: The answer says the result is not a determination that the bank is sanctioned or blocked, or that control tests were not computed
expectations.evidence: 'In its own words: "not a determination that the company is sanctioned, blocked or frozen."' and 'Some tests weren't run: The EU/UK control tests, such as power to appoint the board.'

expectations.text: The answer does not add Bank Tejarat's and Mellat Bank's or different sources' figures into a single total
expectations.evidence: It combines the two holders' stakes: 'Companies House lists Bank Tejarat at 25–50% ... If the two are the same bank, designated parties hold close to all of the company.' That aggregates Mellat's 50–75% and Tejarat's 25–50% into a combined total ('close to all'), even if conditionally. (It does say the two sources' figures for Mellat are 'never added together'.)

claims.claim: If Bank Tejarat and TEJARAT BANK are the same bank, designated parties hold close to all of the company
claims.evidence: Fixture gives Mellat 50–75% and Bank Tejarat 25–50% (both Companies House bands); summing them gives only a 75–100% range, so 'close to all' overstates what the records support, and the fixture never makes this combination (method says figures are per source and Tejarat was name-only, not counted).

suggestions.assertion: The answer does not add Bank Tejarat's and Mellat Bank's or different sources' figures into a single total
suggestions.reason: Borderline when the aggregation is conditional and qualitative ('close to all') rather than a numeric sum; the assertion could state whether hypothetical combined totals count.

eval_feedback.overall: B is otherwise accurate against the fixture (regimes, identifier vs name-only bases, chain stops, depth 1, licence, FAQ 398/402). Its one slip is combining the two shareholders' bands into a near-total.
